summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests adding the TheraBionic P1 device, which uses amplitude-modulated radiofrequency electromagnetic fields, to the drug fruquintinib. It is for metastatic colorectal cancer that has not responded to other standard treatment. The device is used three times daily on a continuous basis, and fruquintinib is taken daily for 3 weeks on and 1 week off, with total study length not stated. The study aims to learn whether adding the device is effective in improving survival and whether it is safe and tolerable.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa agregar el dispositivo TheraBionic P1, que usa campos electromagnéticos de radiofrecuencia modulados en amplitud, al medicamento fruquintinib. Es para cáncer colorrectal metastásico que no ha respondido a otros tratamientos estándar. El dispositivo se usa tres veces al día de forma continua, y el fruquintinib se toma a diario durante 3 semanas seguidas y 1 semana de descanso; la duración total del estudio no se indica. El estudio busca saber si agregar el dispositivo es eficaz para mejorar la supervivencia y si es seguro y tolerable.
who_for: Metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma confirmed by tissue or cell testing, with RAS, BRAF and HER2 status documented.
Progression on or intolerance to fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin or irinotecan chemotherapy.
Prior anti-VEGF therapy and, if RAS is wild type, prior anti-EGFR therapy.
Disease that can be evaluated by CT, MRI or PET scan.
Age 22 or older, body weight at least 40 kg, and ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
not_for: Uncontrolled high blood pressure, or gastrointestinal ulcer, bleeding or perforation risk.
Recent blood clot, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or significant heart disease as listed.
Prolonged QT interval, QT risk factors, or medicines that prolong QT.
Recent systemic cancer treatment, prior fruquintinib, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Live vaccine within 28 days, or use of calcium channel blockers.
